cubit.note: Scripture does not define the cubit. The common cubit is taken as about 45.7 cm (18 inches); a longer “royal” cubit of about 52.4 cm is also used. Both conversions are estimates.

items.label: The court
items.phrase: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty

items.label: A board of the tabernacle
items.phrase: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board

items.label: The tabernacle, south side
items.phrase: twenty boards on the south side

items.label: The tabernacle, west side
items.phrase: westward thou shalt make six boards
items.derivation: 6 boards × 1½ cubits = 9 cubits, plus two corner boards (Exodus 26:23). How the corner boards add to the width is not stated.

items.label: One curtain
items.phrase: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits

items.label: The ark of the testimony
items.phrase: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof
